facts.statement: A birthday party event ran in Free Realms across the zones Joyful Vale, Criqueville, Snowy Hill, Misty Glade, Wugachug, Black Spore, Heather Wood and Sanctuary.
facts.quote: Tu peux faire la fête à la Vallée joyeuse, au Criqueville, à la Colline des Neiges, à la Clairière Embrumée, au Wugachug, au Spore Noire, au Bois des Bruyères et dans le Sanctuaire.

article_summaries.title: Fête d'Anniversaire pour Free Realms!
article_summaries.summary: A French-language SOE news post announcing a Free Realms birthday party event running across all zones. It describes the starting NPC, birthday quests (some member-only), the boss fight against a cake creature with gâtolin helpers, market items, and a set of eight zone cakes that combine into a boss birthday cake reward. The post gives no absolute date, only 'Posted 1 month, 1 week ago' relative to capture.
